description: Discover the best hotels in Surfers Paradise, Australia. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Surfers Paradise Self-Contained Apartment Stay Moments from the Beach with Two Pools & Tennis Courts
hotels.description: Hang ten at this stylish apartment stay, located just 25 metres from the golden sands and first-class waves of Surfer’s Paradise Beach. Backed by showstopping views over the Pacific Ocean, you’ll be all set to discover the city’s best, with Pacific Fair and The Star Gold Coast both easily accessible via the nearby G:link tram. After a day exploring the city's iconic sights, return to the comfort of your self-contained apartment and feel the calming sea breeze from your sun-kissed private balcony. Cool off at one of the hotel's two outdoor pools, the perfect place to laze away the afternoon, have a hit at the onsite tennis courts or cook up a storm in the fully equipped barbecue area.

hotels.title: Family-Friendly Self-Contained Apartments Opposite Surfers Paradise Beach with Three Pools
hotels.description: Experience the vibrancy of Surfers Paradise from the comfort of this modern apart-hotel, where space comes at no premium and convenience is king. Perfectly positioned opposite the golden sands of Surfers Paradise Beach, BreakFree Moroccan Surfers Paradise offers large self-contained apartments with private balconies boasting breathtaking ocean views. Enjoy a dip in one of the three pools, relax in the sauna or keep your fitness regime going in the gym. Explore the nearby Cavill Avenue for shopping, dining and entertainment, or venture further to the Gold Coast Hinterland for a day of adventure with the whole family.

hotels.title: Contemporary Surfers Paradise Escape near Iconic Beach
hotels.description: Moments from Surfers Paradise's golden beachfront, the sophisticated Crowne Plaza Surfers Paradise, an IHG Hotel, sits between the iconic strip and lively Broadbeach. Wake up to the sound of the ocean, plunge into the sparkling outdoor pool and enjoy a bite of the Gold Coast at the poolside Relish Grill & Bar, then visit Dreamworld - just a 30-minute drive - or get a dose of retail therapy at Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, within a 10-minute tram ride.

hotels.vendor_name: Mantra Circle on Cavill Surfers Paradise
hotels.title: Stylish Surfers Paradise Apartment Stay with Private Cinema, Three Pools & Shopping Centre Access
hotels.description: Elevate your Gold Coast stay and discover the perfect home-away-from-home at the Mantra Circle on Cavill Surfers Paradise. Offering apartment-style living and boasting top-notch facilities including a private cinema, three swimming pools, a spa, and direct access to some of the area's best shopping, you'll be in an ideal location to explore Surfers Paradise. Should you venture out, you'll find an array of tantalising eateries, gorgeous sandy beaches and activities for the whole family just a stone's throw away.

hotels.title: Surfers Paradise Self-Contained Apartment Stay with Lagoon-Style Pool & Moments from the Esplanade
hotels.description: Experience the sin-kissed lifestyle of Queensland's Surfers Paradise from the comfort of spacious, self-contained apartments. This coastal resort is a leisurely stroll from the golden sands of Surfers Paradise Beach and the lively Esplanade and Cavill Avenue, known for its vibrant nightlife and shopping. Treat yourself to a refreshing dip in the lagoon-style pool, featuring a waterslide and pirate ship for the kids, or savour time in the sauna for the perfect balance of fun and relaxation.

hotels.title: Beachfront Gold Coast Escape in Surfers Paradise with Lagoon-Style Pool & Restaurant
hotels.description: Experience the vibrant energy of Surfers Paradise with a stay at this sophisticated oceanfront retreat, superbly located just moments from the golden sands of the famous beach. This stylish abode offers contemporary rooms and suites and boasts an array of top-notch facilities, including a heated lagoon-style pool, a fully equipped gym and an onsite restaurant serving a delectable menu. Venture out to explore the nearby Cavill Avenue, brimming with shopping, dining and nightlife options, or take a scenic drive to the lush hinterland of the Gold Coast.

hotels.title: Relaxed Central Surfers Paradise Break near Cavill Avenue with Three Pools
hotels.description: Moments from Surfers Paradise's waves and golden sand, revel in sun-kissed days with an escape near the lively Cavill Avenue bursting with cafes, bars and shopping. Start your days with a bite at Koastal Kitchen, splash around in one of three pools (one with waterslides) or practice your serve at the onsite tennis courts. If that's not enough to keep you entertained, kick up the action at Warner Bros Movie World or Sea World, only a short drive away.

hotels.title: Surfers Paradise Two-Bedroom Apartments with Unlimited Dreamworld & SkyPoint Observation Deck Entry
hotels.description: Find everything you need for an easy family break right in the heart of Surfers Paradise. These self-contained apartments give you space to stretch out and settle in, with full kitchens, laundry facilities and roomy living areas. Positioned above the Chevron Renaissance precinct, you’ll be just steps from casual eateries, supermarkets and everyday essentials, with Surfers Paradise Beach a short walk away. Your package also includes unlimited entry to three of the Gold Coast’s best-loved attractions: spend your days riding rollercoasters and meeting Australian wildlife at Dreamworld, take in panoramic coastal views from the SkyPoint Observation Deck, and make memories with the whole gang at WhiteWater World (seasonal). Back onsite, there's plenty to fill the days between thrilling outings and sightseeing - the 'Beaches in the Sky' area boasts a huge lagoon pool fringed by palms and shaded lawns. Indoor and outdoor lap pools, a gym and a sauna mean there's always something to do, while the onsite theatre beckons quiet nights in.

hotels.title: Modern Surfers Paradise Apartment Escape with Rooftop Lagoon Pool & Sauna
hotels.description: Experience the cosmopolitan charm of the Gold Coast with an elegant stay in the heart of Surfers Paradise. Explore the pristine sands of Surfers Paradise Beach and vibrant Cavill Avenue, before returning to your spacious apartment. Take a dip in the onsite 'Beaches in the Sky' lagoon pool, lounge in the hotel's sauna, or savour a delicious meal at one of the many nearby eateries - there's something for everyone at Mantra Towers of Chevron Surfers Paradise.

hotels.title: Central Gold Coast Stay Minutes from Surfers Paradise Beach & Esplanade
hotels.description: Explore the famous beaches and vibrant streets of Gold Coast's city centre with ease at this ideally located stay. Mere steps away from Surfers Paradise Beach, take time to unwind on your private balcony or indulge in a tranquil treatment or two at onsite Ocean Day Spa and Salon. Dine on chef-served dishes at NOSH Pan Asian or venture out to wander nearby Cavill Avenue, a buzzing hub of trendy bars, restaurants and boutique shopping.

hotels.title: Stylish Novotel Surfers Paradise Escape with Pool Moments from Cavill Avenue
hotels.description: Experience the epitome of Gold Coast sophistication and take in impressive views from all angles at this Surfers Paradise oasis. This high-rise hotel puts the sand and sunshine on your doorstep, with the beach just metres away and the lively atmosphere of Cavill Avenue within easy reach. Exceptional facilities, including a gleaming pool, jet-powered spa and tennis courts, and the onsite BLVD Cafe & Bar are sure to impress. To round out your day, fire up the hotel's BBQ facilities for an alfresco family-friendly feast.

hotels.title: Spacious Surfers Paradise Self-Contained Apartments Metres from the Beach with Two Pools
hotels.description: Enjoy a home away from home in the sparkling Gold Coast with a stay at this collection of stylish apartments, perfectly positioned in the heart of Surfers Paradise. Built above the Paradise Centre shopping complex, retail therapy and the the golden sands of the beach are just moments from your doorstep. Plus the vibrant dining options and eclectic mix of boutiques along Cavill Avenue are also nearby. Each one-, two- or three-bedroom apartment offers stunning ocean views, a fully-equipped kitchen and spacious living areas. Onsite, relax as you please with two outdoor swimming pools, tennis courts, and a spa and sauna.

hotels.title: Family-Friendly Surfers Paradise Fun with Waterpark & Ice-Skating Rink
hotels.description: Unlock core memories with the entire family with an escape to Paradise Resort, where countless family-friendly adventures await. With a tropical-themed water park, ice-skating rink, supervised kids' club, pamper parlour and adventure playground, there is something new to try everyday. Venture outside the award-winning resort to discover even more attractions: iconic Surfers Paradise beach is just metres away.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Family-Friendly Escape with Daily Breakfast, Water Park & Kids' Club Access
hotels.description: Treat your family to the ultimate getaway at this resort, a paradise of fun featuring a thrilling three-storey water park, ice-skating rink and kids' club. This action-packed destination - just minutes from the spectacular beaches of Surfers Paradise - makes for the ultimate family adventure. Known as 'heaven for kids, paradise for parents', this escape lets the little ones explore while you unwind. Dive into the outdoor heated lagoon and sip poolside daiquiris with a variety of onsite dining options, or enjoy endless family fun with a variety of activities, live entertainment and premium facilities, like a jungle gym and climbing wall. You may also step beyond your luxurious retreat for legendary theme park thrills at Dreamworld and WhiteWater World (seasonally available) with heart-pounding rides and experiences for the whole family, including the fresh King Claw ride, towering 27 metres high. Take your holiday to new heights and ascend to the spectacular SkyPoint Observation Deck for 360-degree views from hinterland to horizon.

hotels.title: Surfers Paradise Self-Contained Luxury Apartments on The Esplanade with Beach Club Restaurant, Two Heated Pools & Spa
hotels.description: Discover the magic of the Gold Coast for yourself with a glamorous stay at Peppers Soul Surfers Paradise. Begin your day with a leisurely breakfast at Hyde Paradiso, the hotel's in-house eatery-turned-tapas bar come evening, which offers a tantalising array of artisinal dishes to kick-start your day. Wander down the famous Cavill Avenue, known for colourful dining and shopping, or wander over to the Surfers Paradise Beach for a dip in Pacific waters. When you're ready to unwind, head to the outdoor heated pool, a serene oasis where you can enjoy a refreshing plunge year round. For a deeper level of relaxation, the hotel's sauna and steam room provide a rejuvinating retreat.

hotels.vendor_name: voco Gold Coast, an IHG Hotel
hotels.title: Stylish Surfers Paradise Escape near Cavill Avenue with Two Pools
hotels.description: Sparkling azure waters, pristine white sand and trendy beachfront restaurants await at the modern voco™ Gold Coast. Steps away from the golden shores of Surfers Paradise Beach and the unmissable shopping of Cavill Avenue, this contemporary hotel is the perfect place to soak up the Gold Coast sun. Catch a wave at some of Australia’s best beaches or spend the day exploring the diverse culinary offerings around the hotel, before heading back to your contemporary accommodation for a dip in one of the two pools. Dig into juicy steaks at Clifford's Grill & Lounge or pamper yourself with an indulgent massage at the luxurious L’Aqua Day Spa. At night, kick back on your plush bedding, take in the stunning views and enjoy a restful sleep to prepare for more days of sun, surf and sand.
